failure_patterns.pattern: tool_result_persistence_and_cache_selection: Result calls were left unsaved, nested inside saves or filters, or based on an older cached result.

rejected_edits.content: For hotel searches, map a stated party size to `num_people` only when it is explicitly intended for hotel occupancy; a count specified solely for flight passengers does not automatically set hotel occupancy. Apply a newly supplied hotel count with a same-domain filter on a suitable cached hotel result when needed. Do not infer unspoken hotel counts or pass traveler counts to flight tools. Map criteria only to matching domain fields: “non-stop” flights means `num_layovers=[0]`; “first” or “business” flight class belongs in `flight_class`, not hotel `stars`. For hotels, an explicit request for business facilities maps to `has_business_center=True`; a meeting-room request separately maps to `has_meeting_rooms=True`.
rejected_edits.target: For a hotel search, map any explicitly stated party size to `num_people` (for example, “solo” means `num_people=1`); apply a newly supplied count with a same-domain filter on a suitable cached hotel result when needed. Do not infer unspoken counts or pass traveler counts to flight tools.

rejected_edits.content: If a new constraint is not reflected in cache, choose the latest suitable result that already includes all prior applicable constraints, preferring an updated or filtered result over the original broad search. Retrieve it by its exact cache-summary key into a variable, apply only the new constraint, and save under a fresh key; do not repeat a search when the result can be filtered or rely on variables from earlier turns. For a shared round-trip flight preference, retrieve and update the outbound and return results independently.
rejected_edits.target: If a suitable cached base exists and a new constraint is not reflected in it, retrieve the latest suitable result using `get_results_from_cache(key="<exact key from the cache summary>")` and assign the returned result; do not rely on variables from earlier code or turns.
